# Helper function to shift letters by an amount
def shift_string(text, amount):
    result = []
    for c in text:
        if c.isalpha():
            base = ord('a') if c.islower() else ord('A')
            shifted = chr((ord(c) - base + amount) % 26 + base)
            result.append(shifted)
        else:
            result.append(c)
    return ''.join(result)
